description: ansible-devkit's shared Renovate policy: grouping, schedule, pinning and the Galaxy manager. Repositories extend it PINNED to a release tag (github>Richard-Lynch/ansible-devkit//renovate/default#vX.Y.Z), so it moves only through a reviewed PR in each repository, and every security-relevant automerge decision lives in the repository's own renovate.json, after this preset, where a later preset cannot widen it.

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions: one grouped PR; every action pinned to a commit digest with its tag in a comment (DEP-04).
GitHub's own actions wait several days after a release before Renovate proposes them.
devkit's own reusable workflows stay on release TAGS (CONFORM-04), grouped so a devkit release is one PR.
Collection dependencies are RANGES in a library (DEP-05): widen the range, never pin it.

Python 3.15 is stable but ansible-test supports only 3.12-3.14 and every repo pins 3.12, so Renovate must not propose 3.15 or later: it opened 'Update python Docker tag to v3.15' against .python-version (a dependency named python) and every one failed CI. Remove this rule when ansible-test supports 3.15; tracking issue: https://github.com/Richard-Lynch/ansible-devkit/issues/32
A major bump is opened only from the dependency dashboard.
